correctness.rationale: Exact counts of all Riordan step strings by two distinct algorithms (path enumeration with Walsh transform and signed height-state recurrence), every frequency at n=2..13; 13-step 176 zeros with minimum support five, full weight histogram, least surviving magnitude two. Exact inverse Walsh projection-kernel histogram has l1 mass 35360/8192. Averaging all projections over translations proves this kernel realizes the unrestricted endpoint optimum.

value.rationale: Identifies first length in a canonical named path class where all one- through four-coordinate horizontal parities fail to detect Fourier nonidentifiability, while 22 five-coordinate characters do. Exact rank/nullity and globally optimal endpoint projection constant quantify reconstruction loss and amplification; the finite first-boundary finding is intrinsically motivated, with explicit limits beyond n13.
